claim_boundary: The physical tiny-shape eager matrix qualifies the listed standard recurrent, Transformer layer/stack/top-level, spiking recurrent, SpikingSelfAttention, and Spikformer routes for train/eval and full/remainder/singleton batches on the stated stack. The separate Spikformer representative record qualifies only its explicit eager-training and fixed-evaluation-graph buckets, including shape-specific BF16 latency/HBM evidence and bounded trajectory/canary evidence. AsPy remains BF16 public tensors routed through the unchanged FP32 native ABI. No native BF16 kernel arithmetic, dataset generalization, training Spikformer NPUGraph, custom native Spikformer operator, arbitrary architecture variant, FP8, or family-wide acceleration is qualified.
